title: Log in as a school tenant and reach the home dashboard
description: Verifies a school user can sign in with valid credentials and lands on the school home dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the home dashboard

title: Log out from an authenticated session
description: Verifies that a signed-in school user can log out and is returned to the login screen with the session ended.

steps.description: Verify the user is on the login page
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Logged-out user cannot access an authenticated route after logout
description: Verifies that after logging out, attempting to access an authenticated page is blocked by redirecting to login.

steps.description: Verify the user is on the login page
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Developer dashboard requires authentication
description: Verifies that unauthenticated users cannot access the developer dashboard and are routed to login.

steps.description: Verify the user is prompted to log in

title: Itemized view requires authentication
description: Verifies that unauthenticated users cannot access the itemized breakdown and are routed to login.

steps.description: Verify the user is prompted to log in

title: Tracking view requires authentication
description: Verifies that unauthenticated users cannot access tracking reports and are routed to login.

steps.description: Verify the user is prompted to log in

title: Initialize a new budget and confirm budget workspace is created
description: Verifies a school user can initialize budget for an academic year and term and then see the initialized budget in the budget view.

steps.description: Click the link to initialize the budget
Verify the budget view is displayed for the selected academic context

title: Update budget allocations and see updated totals in grant summary
description: Verifies a school user can edit budget allocations, submit updates, and see totals reflected in the grant summary.

steps.description: Click the link to open the budget view
Edit at least one budget allocation value with a valid amount
Click the link to open the grant summary view
Verify the grant summary totals reflect the updated budget allocations

title: Log out from a non-home authenticated page
description: Verifies that logout works consistently when initiated from another authenticated area and returns the user to login.

steps.description: Verify the user is on the login page
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Add a credit and confirm it appears in the credits register
description: Verifies a school user can add a credit and then see the new credit entry listed in the credits register.

steps.description: Click the link to open the credits view
Fill a valid amount into the credit amount field
Fill a unique reference text into the credit reference field
Select a valid date for the credit
Verify the credits list includes a credit entry with the submitted reference text

title: Add a debit and access its document options from the debits register
description: Verifies a school user can add a debit, select it in the register, and see document actions available for that debit.

steps.description: Click the link to open the debits view
Fill a valid amount into the debit amount field
Fill a unique vendor or description text into the debit description field
Select a valid date for the debit
Select the newly created debit row in the debits list
Verify document options or a document preview area is available for the selected debit

title: User can log in again after logging out
description: Verifies that after logging out, the user can sign in again and reach the authenticated home page.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the home dashboard
Verify dashboard grant totals are displayed

title: Developer can view the multi-school dashboard list
description: Verifies that an authenticated developer can open the developer dashboard and see a list of schools with subscription status information.

steps.description: Enable developer mode if the login form provides a developer toggle
Click the navigation item to open the developer dashboard
Verify a list of schools is displayed
Verify subscription status information is displayed for at least one school

title: Logout route ends the session when visited directly
description: Verifies that visiting the logout route ends any active session and results in the login screen being shown.

steps.description: Verify the user is on the login page
Verify the login form is displayed

title: Developer can edit a school's subscription or metadata and see the update reflected
description: Verifies that editing a school's subscription or metadata from the developer dashboard persists and is visible after saving.

steps.description: Enable developer mode if the login form provides a developer toggle
Click the navigation item to open the developer dashboard
Select a school row from the list
Change an editable subscription or metadata field to a different valid value
Verify the updated value is shown for that school in the dashboard list

title: Itemized view shows itemized budget breakdown
description: Verifies that an authenticated school user can open the itemized page and see an itemized budget breakdown for the current academic context.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the itemized view
Verify an itemized budget breakdown is displayed

title: View tracking reports for the current academic context
description: Verifies a school user can open the tracking view and see budget tracking/reporting data for the current year and term.

steps.description: Click the link to open the tracking view
Verify budget tracking or reporting data is displayed

title: Tracking view shows trend and status reporting
description: Verifies that an authenticated school user can open the tracking page and view trend/status reporting for budget tracking.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the tracking view
Verify budget tracking trend or status report content is displayed

title: Update school settings and see changes reflected in the UI
description: Verifies a school user can modify a settings value, save it, and see the updated setting reflected on the settings page.

steps.description: Click the link to open the settings view
Modify a settings field with a new valid value
Verify the settings view reflects the updated value

title: Download budget export as an Excel file
description: Verifies a school user can trigger the budget Excel export from the budget workspace and receives a downloadable file.

steps.description: Click the link to open the budget view
Click the control to export the budget to Excel
Verify an Excel file download is initiated

title: Show validation when required credit field is missing
description: Verifies the credits form blocks submission when a required field is missing and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Click the link to open the credits view
Fill a valid amount into the credit amount field
Verify a credit form validation error is visible

title: Request password reset OTP page is accessible from an authenticated session
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can open the OTP request page and see the OTP entry UI.
category: Password reset (OTP) and set new password

steps.description: Click the link or menu item to start the password reset OTP flow
Verify the OTP entry form is displayed

title: Show validation when password is missing on login
description: Verifies submitting the login form without a password shows an on-page validation error and does not log the user in.

steps.description: Fill invalid_user into the username field
Verify a login form validation error is visible

title: Incorrect OTP is rejected with a validation error
description: Verifies that submitting an incorrect OTP shows a validation error and does not proceed to the new password page.
category: Password reset (OTP) and set new password

steps.description: Fill an incorrect OTP into the OTP field
Verify an OTP validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the OTP verification step

title: New password form enforces required inputs
description: Verifies that submitting the new password form with missing required fields shows validation and does not complete the reset.
category: Password reset (OTP) and set new password

steps.description: Leave the new password field empty
Verify a required-field validation error is visible
Verify the password reset is not completed
